steps.text: SHM: acceleration is proportional to displacement and directed toward equilibrium, a = −ω²x.
x = A cos(ωt) or x = A sin(ωt); the period T = 2π/ω is independent of amplitude.
Energy swaps between kinetic and potential; total energy = ½mω²A².
Simple pendulum (small angles): T = 2π√(L/g), independent of mass and amplitude.
Mass on a spring: T = 2π√(m/k), independent of amplitude.
Damping reduces amplitude; resonance peaks when driving frequency equals natural frequency.
